name: Descriptor-Patches Benchmark
description: A benchmark and evaluation suite of handcrafted and learned local image patch descriptors for measuring descriptor matching and retrieval performance.
reputation: Widely used in the local descriptor / feature matching community as a standard suite for comparing handcrafted and learned patch descriptors.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark focused on patch-level matching and retrieval; some tasks can be saturated by modern learned descriptors and results vary by evaluation protocol (synthetic vs. real).
